The Pending claim lasts 120 s with no heartbeat, as the local registry's PENDING_TTL does. A stream running longer than 120 s lets a duplicate start a second run on another replica; renew the claim on a timer in the owner before the flip.

results.notes:
Built with MODEL_GATEWAY_SHARED_IDEMPOTENCY off by default (strict "true" parser via mp_contracts::loop_fold::switch_from). With the switch off, shared_store() returns None before any connect or read, so the send path is unchanged.

idempotency_registry.rs (CRLF kept): a SharedClaimStore trait seam (claim / get / settle), a Redis implementation of it, and CommitGuard::claim_shared / record_run. Redis does SET NX PX on mp:gw:idem:{org}\x1f{user}\x1f{key} with Pending 120 s and Done 600 s. The value holds only request_id, run_id, thread_id and state, never answer text. The key is built from the same identity-scoped key as the local map, so another tenant derives a different key.

When the guard drops, the shared claim becomes Done only if the stream buffered its `done` frame; any other end deletes it, so a failed turn can be retried with the same key. The Redis store has its own 250 ms op timeout and 5 s cooldown breaker, so an outage degrades to local behaviour.

sse.rs (LF kept): invoke_resume_sse is split into a thin handler plus resume_stream_for(state, org, user, request_id, after_seq). In invoke_sse, a local InFlight claim looks up the shared record, and a local Proceed then takes the shared claim; if another request holds it, the duplicate calls attach_to_original (resume_stream_for from frame 0) and the local claim is released. If the original is no longer resumable it answers `duplicate_in_flight` with the original request_id. ZDR returns before the claim, so a ZDR turn never claims. The unary /v1/invoke path is untouched.

Tests (13 new): switch parser, key scoping, ids-only value, two replicas attach, foreign org does not attach, outage falls back to local, Done claim names the run, abandoned stream removes its claim, settle never touches another request's claim, attach replays the original's frames, evicted original gives an error naming it, a foreign identity cannot attach, resume of an unknown stream is still a 404.
